description.value: Saint Germain Bakery is an award-winning Canadian bakery chain founded in the mid-1980s, having earned multiple Gold Medals at the Culinary Olympics in Germany and supplied desserts to nine airlines and major hotel chains. The bakery draws on techniques from pastry chefs in France, Japan, Hong Kong, and Australia, using natural ingredients like whole vanilla beans, fresh cream from Calgary, and seasonal local fruit. This Richmond location is a mall-based shop — a handy refuelling stop for cyclists seeking fresh baked goods.
